ns2:course.label: Nonlinear Dynamics
ns2:course.description: Broad introduction to nonlinear dynamics of physical systems with varying degrees of complexity; surveys a variety of concepts associated with bifurcation phenomena, mappings, nonlinear oscillations, chaotic behavior, strange attractors, solitons, and topics of current interest. Prerequisite: One of MATH 241 (formerly MATH 243), MATH 380, MATH 385; PHYS 326.
